required_checks: Per-method source preparation, actual native stage, primary review, source-coverage review, correction and terminal outcome
Replay native transport evidence, requested model/effort, singleton distinct threads, stage order and recorded usage
Independently inspect material routing, controls, alternatives, information claims and interface qualifiers, including accepted outputs
Distinguish unsupported claims, missed evidence, document-rendition limitations, inaccessible evidence and operational failures
Inspect publication, discovered units, actual shared-operation admission and overlay; do not infer ancestry or interchangeability from similarity
Verify durable archive and preserve limitations of original-document provenance separately

known_reporting_limitations.observation: The driver writes integration.json before its final result.update and does not write it again there.
known_reporting_limitations.consequence: Read experiment_state.json.integration and underlying receipts for the final shared status, assignments and graph hashes.

known_reporting_limitations.observation: The top-level completed status permits partial extraction outcomes and no supported parents; nested stages retain their own dispositions.
known_reporting_limitations.consequence: Report each of the ten methods and each integration gate separately.

known_reporting_limitations.observation: trace_audit records events and duplicate IDs without enforcing transport consistency or intended role/configuration checks; command_events can include both started and completed events.
known_reporting_limitations.consequence: Replay transport and count unique command items independently.

known_reporting_limitations.observation: Validators check recorded target and obligation accounting, source bindings and quote integrity; they do not mechanically establish every natural-language clause.
known_reporting_limitations.consequence: Accepted outputs still require independent scientific spot checks; no whole-graph accuracy claim follows.

known_reporting_limitations.observation: Typed original-document bindings are preserved/rebound but not delivered as native image context in this production path.
known_reporting_limitations.consequence: Do not claim visual inspection of originals or full recovery of details only present in images.

monitoring_environment_note: A subsequent lightweight inspection command used the Python environment without loading its module and failed to find libpython. This was a monitoring-shell setup error, not evidence of failure in the running Slurm job.
